messages:
oliver: Heads-up — we're planning a rootfs trim for the next base image: remove SUIDs, drop CAP_NET_RAW from helpers, and remove a few legacy packages. Need to coordinate RBAC for the bake pipeline and add an audit-hook. Window target: next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC.

maya: quick Q — are we signing the rebuilt image with the same KMS key or using a temporary key for the churn?

rachel: we'll want a short-lived signing key + cross-sign with prod key to avoid breaking pinning. ops should be able to verify chain. Also need an RBAC change: image-bakers role currently has cluster-admin for convenience — we must scope it to namespaces and the GCR push SA.

sec-oncall: :raised_hand: please add structured audit events to the image pipeline so we can trace who triggered the bake and which key was used. Ideally push to our audit log tenant with fields: actor, action, image_sha, key_id.

jen: SGTM. Can we add a pre-deploy hook that writes a JSON line to /var/log/image-audit.log and forwards to log-shipper? Minimal example: 

```bash
# pre-flight hook snippet
echo '{"actor":"$USER","action":"bake","image":"'$IMAGE'","key":"'$KEY_ID'"}' >> /var/log/image-audit.log
```

sam: about RBAC — I can draft a least-priv policy. Proposal: grant image-baker service account these perms: storage.objects.create on the image bucket, iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob if using KMS agent, and no cluster wide creation rights. Will post a YAML later.

oliver: perfect. Two more ops questions: 1) rollback path if something behaves badly (runtime crash), 2) how consumers pin images (digest vs tag) — we need a clear rollback doc.

rachel: rollback plan: keep previous signed image in the registry with a prebaked canary tag. If we detect regressions we flip router config to the previous image digest and alert. We should also keep a cosign key revocation workflow ready if a signing mistake happens.

maya: KMS note: using an ephemeral key complicates revocations for rollbacks. Alternative: sign with a subkey that is authorized by the main key; keep main key offline. Ops: need to confirm if current keystore supports key versioning and envelope encryption.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled bake job created for 2026-03-30T02:00:00Z (job id jb-8247). Notifications will post to #eng-runtime and #eng-oncall.

sec-oncall: Can we add an automated smoke test after bake that runs a quick start container with minimal traffic, checks /health and latency p90 < 200ms? If it fails we auto-fail the rollout and route back.

jen: yes — I'll add a post-bake smoke stage in CI with a 10-min window. Failure will trigger a rollback playbook that includes: revert routing, open incident channel, and preserve failing image for forensics.

sam: drafting RBAC YAML now. One wrinkle: some internal teams pin by tag 'latest-stable' — we must communicate to freeze tags for the maintenance window. I'll add a repo notice and send a checklist.

oliver: thanks — checklist items: 1) RBAC PR merged 48h before window, 2) audit-hook in staging, 3) signing flow validated (KMS and cosign), 4) smoke tests green, 5) rollback playbook published.

rachel: pinging @platform-eng to confirm keystore support for subkeys and signBlob. Also we should run a small canary cohort (5%) for 30min before full cutover.

maya: FYI — dependency scanner flagged libfoo and xz-utils as rebuild targets; will remove xz-utils runtime unless something breaks.

jen: will add an incident tag in the smoke pipeline that archives /var/log/image-audit.log and copies cosign metadata to S3 for the forensics team on failure.

sec-oncall: good. One ask: add a field "audit_trace_id" in every audit line so we can tie runtime traces back to the bake event.

oliver: noted. I'll follow up with the release notes and Send calendar invites. If no objections I want the RBAC PR by EOD Friday so we can hit Tue window. :thumbsup:

rachel: no objections from security side. :eyes:

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/4321 — includes ServiceAccount policy and minimal rbac. Will request reviews from @rachel @maya.

jen: I pushed the hook to staging branch: https://git.internal/repo/ops/hooks/commit/ab12c. Smoke job defined under jb-8247.

oliver: thanks all — we'll reconvene Mon 16:00 UTC for a final preflight.

sec-oncall: I'll prepare a runbook section for postmortem if we need it.

ops-bot: checklist status: RBAC PR: open, Audit hook: staging, Signing verification: pending, Smoke tests: pending.

maya: adding a short note to #customers-facing-apis to expect a brief maintenance advisory during the window.

oliver: closing this thread for now — ping @everyone in Monday sync if anything blocks.
